summary: Final submission registers the one sourced lead the run did not test, rather than leaving it in the transcript. The mechanism is the same blocking send that the startup-replay finding turns into a constructor deadlock, but in the running case the consumer exists: the leader's main loop delivers committed entries to the FSM through a fixed-capacity channel whose only reader is the FSM goroutine, and the FSM contract asks for determinism without bounding how long Apply may block. So when commits outpace the FSM, the channel fills and the main loop blocks inside processLogs — unable to process RPCs, answer clients, or run its own lease check — while the replication goroutines keep heartbeating. I recorded that as a behaviour with its anchors (the blocking send, the channel creation, the single consumer, and the Apply contract text), and opened it as a paused question with a concrete discriminator: a real cluster whose FSM sleeps inside Apply, commit traffic faster than the FSM drains, an independent probe of the main loop, and controls with a fast FSM and a bounded apply rate, the point being to settle whether any internal repair exists or whether the only response is the caller's own backpressure — a question I deliberately did not answer from source alone. That leaves the run where I can honestly stand behind it: three execution-grounded findings with retained receipts, witnesses and scoped limits — the startup replay that blocks NewRaft once the committed-but-unapplied window exceeds the FSM channel's batch capacity, the nonvoter acknowledgement that satisfies VerifyLeader's voter quorum and, under per-node timers, can accompany committed state the confirming leader never applied, and the membership change that installs a voter immediately against two published descriptions that promise staging and can strand a single-voter cluster until the added server runs — plus four refuted suspicions and one excluded cause with the evidence that settled each, one behaviour entry corrected under its own id with its affected use answered, twelve registered questions answered, no necessary gap outstanding, and this one paused lead with its anchors and discriminator for whoever continues.
